info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Marketing By Advertising Id-spec
info.description: The Marketing Information Retrieval API enables businesses to obtain marketing data associated with a specific advertising identifier. This endpoint allows users to pull details such as campaign performance, target demographics, and engagement metrics linked to advertising efforts. Typical consumers of this API include marketing analysts and data scientists who require insights for reporting and optimization. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their advertising strategies based on actionable data.

get.summary: Retrieve advertising details for the specified resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about the advertising resource identified by RES-100045. It provides insights into the campaign performance, target demographics, and engagement metrics.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving advertising details. This body must contain necessary information that specifies what advertising campaign data is being requested.
